description: A contemporary Scandinavian-influenced residential garden photographed at dusk, capturing the blue hour transition between natural daylight and artificial illumination. The background features a low, flat-roofed modern house with exterior cladding in warm natural pine horizontal boards, a projecting flat roof fascia in pale concrete or render, and large glass sliding doors that glow warmly amber from interior lighting. The garden planting is lush and naturalistic — tall feathery ornamental grasses sway in the foreground, their golden seed heads catching warm light; a large rounded low-growing ground cover plant with broad dark leaves fills the mid-ground; small yellow flowering plants carpet the base of the planting bed; and low ornamental shrubs fill the background border. A narrow cobblestone or sett pathway runs along the near edge of the planting bed, its surface picking up a soft ambient glow. The sky is a soft cool periwinkle-grey of approaching dusk with no cloud detail. The warm amber glow falling from a low source illuminates the grasses and the base of the planting bed, creating a warm pool of light that emphasizes the texture and movement of the garden plants. Camera is at a low-to-seated eye-level, approximately 2–3 feet, shooting an off-center composition that places the path and grasses in the foreground with the house softly out of focus in the background. The lens is a moderate wide angle with shallow depth of field compressing the garden depth. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
